name: Miiden no Nichijou: 22-sai Buddy-hen
original_name: みーでんの日常　22歳バディ編
source:
A super-short novel depicting the casual daily life of Ann Crosea and Yodogawa Suzaku, two buddies in the magical soldier organization Mileden!

Listen to their stories, ask them questions, and enjoy their buddy interactions!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11257]Novelgame[/url]]
